description:
1. Create a temporary workspace named "temp_var_workspace" and record the current access permissions and ownership snapshot of /var into "var_access_snapshot.txt" within that workspace.  
2. Generate and save a complete recursive listing of all entries under /var into "var_listing.txt" inside the workspace, preserving full paths and attributes for each entry.  
3. From "var_listing.txt", produce "var_files_only.txt" by excluding directory entries and non-regular file types, then record the line count of "var_files_only.txt" into "var_files_intermediate_count.txt" and verify the file is readable.  
4. Consolidate "var_files_only.txt", "var_files_intermediate_count.txt", and "var_access_snapshot.txt" into a single verification file "var_count_metadata.txt" and confirm consistency so the prepared dataset is ready for the final count.

What is the total number of files in the /var directory? (recursively)
